evals.prompt: The Photos source album still has the same count, but one UUID was replaced after retrieval. Decide whether the run may proceed.
evals.expected_output: Fail closed because the source membership fingerprint changed even though the count did not.
assertions: Reports a fingerprint mismatch
Does not accept count equality as sufficient evidence

evals.prompt: Assign candidates with overlapping eligible views to exact view quotas, then repeat with candidate and view order changed.
evals.expected_output: Produce the same feasible assignment regardless of input order and report per-view capacity when infeasible.
assertions: Meets every exact quota
Assignment is deterministic
Infeasible cases name the short view and available capacity

evals.prompt: Overall precision is high, but uncertainty is excessive and one material view has no decisive evidence.
evals.expected_output: Fail the evaluation and identify both the uncertainty and weak-view gates.
assertions: Keeps decisive precision separate from uncertainty
Evaluates material views independently
Does not let an aggregate score conceal a weak stratum

evals.prompt: Apply a reordered feedback file, then try duplicate, unknown, missing, and stale-sample decisions.
evals.expected_output: Apply valid decisions by UUID and reject every malformed or stale decision set.
assertions: Never joins feedback by row position
Rejects duplicate, unknown, and missing UUIDs
Rejects a mismatched sample hash

evals.prompt: One item is restricted and another item in the same duplicate or burst group appears clear.
evals.expected_output: Route the whole related group out of the general master until a human editor resolves it.
assertions: Propagates unresolved safety state across duplicate groups
Propagates unresolved safety state across burst groups
Automated processing cannot clear the group

evals.prompt: Evaluation passed, but master membership, a primary-view assignment, or the governing config changed before plan generation.
evals.expected_output: Reject the plan because the reviewed candidate is no longer the candidate being committed.
assertions: Binds the passing evaluation to exact master membership and assignments
Binds the passing evaluation to the governing config
Rejects a plan after either binding changes

evals.prompt: Inspection says previews were exported, but one file is missing, truncated, mislabeled, duplicated, or not a decodable image.
evals.expected_output: Fail before visual review and identify the affected synthetic UUID.
assertions: Verifies expected preview coverage
Verifies image structure rather than file existence alone
Rejects ambiguous preview-to-UUID mappings

evals.prompt: A proposed final holdout reuses decisions that were already used to tune retrieval and selection.
evals.expected_output: Report contamination and fail the configured fresh-evidence floor.
assertions: Measures fresh UUIDs against all prior tuning rounds
Can require a completely disjoint final holdout
Reports reused identifiers without exposing real archive IDs

evals.prompt: The materialized run state is corrupt and a stale worker attempts a completion transition.
evals.expected_output: Recover from the append-only ledger, reject the stale revision, and require a checksummed artifact for completion.
assertions: Ledger recovery restores the current revision
Compare-and-swap rejects stale workers
Completed phases bind an artifact checksum

evals.prompt: Select a synthetic 4,000-item editor field with exact quotas on a CI-class machine.
evals.expected_output: Return 4,000 unique assignments with exact quotas within the bounded benchmark budget.
assertions: Produces exactly 4,000 unique UUIDs
Meets all configured quotas
Completes within the documented local benchmark threshold

evals.prompt: A final holdout has fresh UUIDs but shares perceptual, duplicate, or burst clusters with tuning decisions and regression canaries.
evals.expected_output: Fail the holdout as contaminated while keeping private identifiers out of the default report.
assertions: Audits UUID and relationship-cluster overlap
Rejects repeated relationship clusters inside the holdout
Treats tuning and regression canaries as separate prior evidence
Defaults to counts and digests rather than raw identifiers

evals.prompt: A worker tries to advance a later phase before its predecessors and later reuses an execution attempt identifier.
evals.expected_output: Reject both transitions and preserve the append-only run history.
assertions: Enforces configured phase order
Rejects reused attempt identifiers
Retains compare-and-swap and checksummed completion evidence

evals.prompt: The installed helper has the expected bundle identity but lacks membership-only writes or support for the plan schema.
evals.expected_output: Block release before Photos mutation and name the missing capability or schema support.
assertions: Checks helper identity and binary digest
Negotiates required capabilities
Rejects unsupported plan schemas

evals.prompt: A plausible write receipt has matching counts but names a different plan, source, helper binary, or catalog topology.
evals.expected_output: Reject the receipt because it does not attest the exact authorized execution.
assertions: Binds receipt to the exact plan digest
Binds source and helper identity
Checks folder and album topology rather than totals alone

evals.prompt: Two production receipts are copies or come from the same launch nonce, while another pair comes from distinct launches but resolves different catalog identifiers.
evals.expected_output: Reject both false idempotence claims and accept only distinct semantically equivalent executions.
assertions: Requires distinct launch nonces and completion times
Requires the same authorized plan and helper
Requires equivalent resulting catalog topology

evals.prompt: Build a website handoff from an editor field containing unknown rights, unresolved consent, unsupported captions, and private archive columns.
evals.expected_output: Emit only specifically cleared rows through an allowlist with opaque public IDs; keep the rest closed.
assertions: Keeps editor-field membership separate from publication clearance
Requires rights, consent, and claim states independently
Excludes stable archive IDs, People data, OCR, locations, and local paths
